thread:
Michael Rivera: FYI renewal invoice for Solstice Medical (private deployment) flagged in CRM. Annual renewal shows platform fee jump from $18,000/mo to $22,000/mo on the renewal line. Customer says contract didn't approve a rate increase. Can billing confirm source?

Priya Nair: they signed an addendum in Jan to extend commitment but I don't recall an explicit unit price change. I have the signed doc scanned. attaching contract_addendum_2026-01.pdf to the ticket.

Omar Lin: pulling invoices + contract. quick check: renewal schedule should use the locked-in rate for existing seats unless opt-in to new pricing. the PDF you attached shows "amendment: extended term" but no unit rate change. suspect billing system defaulted to list price for new term.

billing-bot: Uploaded contract_addendum_2026-01.pdf to billing bucket. Related invoice: INV-2026-06-01-RENEW. total_due: $259,200. link: https://s3.redwood/internal/invoices/INV-2026-06-01-RENEW.pdf

Michael Rivera: total_due seems to be annual at $21,600/mo * 12 = $259,200. but legacy pricing should be $18k/mo -> $216,000. so ~ $43,200 delta.

Omar Lin: yep. system applied new catalog price of $21,600 instead of legacy $18,000. also noticed support tier line moved them from Standard to Enterprise at $8k/mo (was $3k/mo). that adds another $60k annually. combined delta ~ $103,200.

Priya Nair: customer explicitly declined Enterprise when we discussed renewal. they accepted term extension only. they will push back hard.

Kayla Ford: finance note: credits >$5k require director sign-off; >$50k needs VP. If we messed up system pricing, we'll likely need to issue a full corrective credit. escalate now.

Omar Lin: proposed remediation steps: 1) Recalculate invoice using legacy rates, 2) issue reversing credit for overcharge, 3) patch billing catalog entry to avoid repeat, 4) send corrected invoice. Simple calc snippet below.

Omar Lin: ```python
legacy_platform_month = 18000
legacy_support_month = 3000
new_platform_month = 21600
new_support_month = 8000
quantity_months = 12
delta = ((new_platform_month - legacy_platform_month) + (new_support_month - legacy_support_month)) * quantity_months
# delta = ((3600) + (5000)) * 12 = 103200
```

Priya Nair: please include audit trail of who approved price change in system. If it's a bug we should issue full $103,200 credit and apologize. Customer retention at risk.

Michael Rivera: tagging @Kayla Ford for sign-off path. Kayla, can you provisionally approve a corrective credit up to $110k pending Omar's reconciliation?

Kayla Ford: provisional OK to correct up to $110k assuming root cause is internal system error and no negotiated Enterprise rate exists. I'll need the corrected invoice and a short note for audit (reason, approver, ticket id).

billing-bot: INV-2026-06-01-RENEW status: pending_correction. Ticket created: BILL-78924. Audit log entry generated.

Omar Lin: I'll run full ledger match and produce corrected invoice by EOD. will attach CSV of line items and the user action log showing catalog change.

Priya Nair: thanks. I'll draft a customer-facing message offering an apology, corrected invoice, and a 1-month complimentary discount on platform fees as a goodwill gesture (if we need to soften).

Michael Rivera: agree on 1-month credit if needed. keep legal in the loop if they escalate. closing loop once corrected invoice is posted.

Kayla Ford: thanks team. remind me to include this in monthly billing postmortem.

billing-bot: Payment reminder for INV-2026-06-01-RENEW suspended until correction complete.
